# Netcraft Domain Detection — Operations

Latest Domain Detection results from the Integration Gateway (`NetcraftDomainDetection_CL`). Use `NetcraftDomainDetection_Latest` so re-delivered `update` events collapse to one row per `DomainResultId`. Tags are an array of objects; expand `Tag.display_name`. `Risk` is the `data.risk` object; charts and filters use `Risk.category`.

content.query:
NetcraftDomainDetection_Latest
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend RiskCategory = tostring(Risk.category)
| summarize Events = count() by RiskCategory
| order by Events desc
content.title: Results by risk

content.query:
NetcraftDomainDetection_Unique
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Events = count() by ChangeType
| order by Events desc
content.title: Deliveries by change_type

content.query:
NetcraftDomainDetection_Latest
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize
    NewlyRegistered = countif(tostring(Tags) contains "Newly Registered"),
    PreemptiveDisruption = countif(tostring(Tags) contains "Preemptive Disruption")
| project Metrics = pack_array(
    bag_pack("Metric", "Newly Registered", "Count", NewlyRegistered),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Preemptive Disruption", "Count", PreemptiveDisruption))
| mv-expand Metrics
| project Metric = tostring(Metrics.Metric), Count = tolong(Metrics.Count)
content.title: Tag highlights (Newly Registered / Preemptive Disruption)

content.query:
NetcraftDomainDetection_Latest
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend TagArray = iff(gettype(Tags) == "string", parse_json(tostring(Tags)), Tags)
| mv-expand Tag = TagArray
| extend TagName = tostring(Tag.display_name)
| where TagName startswith "Newly Registered" or TagName =~ "Preemptive Disruption"
| summarize Events = count() by TagName
| order by Events desc
content.title: Count by selected tags

content.query:
NetcraftDomainDetection_Latest
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend TagArray = iff(gettype(Tags) == "string", parse_json(tostring(Tags)), Tags)
| mv-expand Tag = TagArray
| extend TagName = tostring(Tag.display_name)
| where isnotempty(TagName)
| summarize Events = count() by TagName
| order by Events desc
| take 20
content.title: Top tags (display_name)

content.query:
NetcraftDomainDetection_Unique
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), ChangeType
| render timechart
content.title: Event volume over time

content.query:
NetcraftDomainDetection_Latest
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where tostring(Risk.category) in ("highest", "high")
| project TimeGenerated, Hostname, Domain, Risk, Tags, ChangeType, CloudEventType, Registrar, IpAddresses, DomainResultId, AreaId, FirstSeen, LastSeen, DetectedAt
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: High / highest risk results

content.query:
NetcraftDomainDetection_Latest
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where tostring(Tags) contains "Newly Registered" or tostring(Tags) contains "Preemptive Disruption"
| project TimeGenerated, Hostname, Domain, Risk, Tags, ChangeType, CloudEventType, DomainResultId, AreaId, FirstSeen, LastSeen, DetectedAt
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: Results with Newly Registered or Preemptive Disruption

content.query:
NetcraftDomainDetection_Latest
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| project TimeGenerated, Hostname, Domain, HostnamePunycode, Risk, ChangeType, CloudEventType, Tags, Registrar, HostingProviders, IpAddresses, DomainResultId, AreaId, TrancoRank, ScreenshotId, FirstSeen, LastSeen, DetectedAt, UpdatedAt, DomainRegisteredAt
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 200
content.title: Latest results
